metadata.title: Almost Homogeneity Characterizes Almost Bi-Lipschitz Euclidean Embeddability
metadata.abstract: A metric space admits an almost bi-Lipschitz embedding into a Euclidean space if and only if it is almost homogeneous. We prove the sufficient direction, complementing the known necessary condition. More quantitatively, we bound the target dimension and the embedding constants for every logarithmic exponent $\gamma>1$. The bounds depend only on the covering parameters in the almost homogeneity condition. In particular every doubling metric space admits such an embedding. This answers a question of Margaris and Robinson and the almost bi-Lipschitz part of a question of Olson and Robinson. As a consequence, the difference set of the image is doubling, which answers the difference-set questions of Olson and Robinson and of Margaris.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 近 bi-Lipschitz Euclid 可嵌入性的刻画
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明度量空间可近 bi-Lipschitz 嵌入某个有限维 Euclid 空间，当且仅当其 almost homogeneous；补齐此前必要条件的充分方向。对每个对数指数 γ>1，目标维数和嵌入常数仅依赖覆盖参数，特别任意 doubling 空间均可这样嵌入，并称像的差集亦 doubling。
techniques: almost homogeneity 的多尺度覆盖
带对数修正的近 bi-Lipschitz 嵌入
像差集的 doubling 控制
analysis.breakthrough: 统一回答 Margaris–Robinson 和 Olson–Robinson 的相关嵌入/差集问题。
analysis.limitations: 近 bi-Lipschitz 含对数畸变，不等于普通 bi-Lipschitz；γ严格大于1，不能顺推临界指数。almost homogeneous、差集与嵌入的精确定义需正文核验。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
